name: Ginetex Care Symbols
about: Ginetex Care Symbols is a free, open-source icon set with 50 icons designed by YESSIR Organization. From navigation and actions to files, media and communication, it covers everyday UI needs. Every icon is available as SVG, PNG and WebP, or as a copy-paste React / TypeScript component or CDN link. Recolor and resize each one in the browser before you export – free, no account needed. Licensed under MIT.

faqs.q: Are Ginetex Care Symbols free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All 50 Ginetex Care Symbols are open source under the MIT license – free to download, customize and use. Always check the MIT terms for attribution or commercial-use requirements.

faqs.q: How do I use Ginetex Care Symbols in React or my website?
faqs.a: Copy any icon as a React / TypeScript component straight into your project, or paste the CDN link into your HTML. Every icon also downloads as SVG, PNG or WebP, and you can recolor and resize it in the browser before you export.

faqs.q: How many Ginetex Care Symbols are there?
faqs.a: There are 50 icons in the Ginetex Care Symbols set, designed by YESSIR Organization. Use the search above to find any icon by name.

faqs.q: Can I change the color and size of Ginetex Care Symbols?
faqs.a: Yes. Open any icon, pick a size and color, and the preview updates instantly. SVG, PNG and WebP exports follow your choices, and React snippets recolor through props.

faqs.q: What formats are Ginetex Care Symbols available in?
faqs.a: SVG, PNG and WebP downloads, copy-paste React / TypeScript components, plus a CDN link for every single icon – free, no account needed.
